All unsafe removed: BDD ops read nodes by value and are iterative; src/psa and src/tra compiled under #![forbid(unsafe_code)].

New exact flow encoding over the Ball-Larus DAG plus an O(V+E) path-count DP using an unbounded PathCount; the BDD #SAT is cross-checked against the DP and loops are flagged separately (PSA_FLAG_HAS_LOOPS).
The aliasing slice is gone: apply, not, restrict and exists copy nodes out before allocating. The mmap.rs SAFETY note is handed off.

Topological seed with each block's in and out edges adjacent, FORCE with a span stop rule, real sifting, per-function node budget and deadline that degrade to a 'summary unavailable' record, fully iterative ops.
Longest path is now an O(V+E) DP over the back-edge-free DAG; loops get a flag and saturation gets its own flag.

Aliasing filter removed. Predicate variables now get their own levels, the x_true/x_false implications are added and the variables are quantified out. Canonical predicates need a Phase 5 producer (handoff); until then nothing is filtered and the PSA flag says so.

Real Rudell sifting on the final compacted ROBDD: in-place adjacent swaps, per-variable unique subtables, refcounts, perm/invperm, 1.2x growth cutoff, swap and time budget, result kept only if smaller and #SAT unchanged.

SHA-256 digests of canonical artifact content (no mtimes or CRC links), chained as h_i = H(h_{i-1}||label||d_i) at 256 bits. Per-entity stable keys and content digests, chain checked on load and by Invariant 3, real SSA digest written to PSA.ssa_hash.

Real per-entity delta in tra (match by stable key; added/removed/modified/relocated; propagation to enclosing declarations and transitive callers). Salsa, tree-sitter reparse and the scpg apply_delta are outside my paths.

In my paths: the u8/u16 truncations in feasibility are removed, TRA span lines widened to u32, ssa_bi no longer aliases def_block for functions over 256 blocks. Ingestion, ssa and cg casts are handed off.

Span parent links give O(log N + depth) forward queries, cs query is O(log N + k), dense uml_slots give O(1) uml_link()/source_range(). Consumers in navigation and class_diagram are handed off.

Persistent lossy computed and not tables, Fx hashing, iterative ops, mark-compact of the root sub-DAG before serialization, order check in verify_canonicity. Complement edges, ITE and refcount GC are not implemented.

Query API added (psa::query: count with required/forbidden edges, paths through an edge, feasibility, witness). Tarjan order used without .rev(), per-function parallelism via std::thread::scope, recursion flagged honestly. No interprocedural composition.
PathGraph builds edge-id CSR in O(V+E); variables are indexed by edge id so parallel edges stay distinct; all edge_index_of scans removed.

Indexes built once (children, supertypes, call sites by caller, UML links by binary search); sequence building bounded and memoized; per-class info logging removed; no rayon added.

Guards for true/false/switch/exception edges, loop depth, handler and decision nodes, end_node_count, labels from statement token spans with char-safe truncation, and labels interned into label_texts.

Package dependency edges, Tarjan cycles, Martin Ca/Ce/I/A/D, components from DI beans and packages with interface lists; no build or deployment metadata exists in the corpus, so that stays explicitly unavailable.

Fuzz target skipped (tests); inspect wording handed off.

All 11 sections now hold full columnar indexes (tokens, files, AST ranges, symbols+stable ids, hierarchy, call graph+SCC+reach index, SDG, spans, UML, ROBDD nodes, canonical .cfa), 64B/4KiB aligned with CRC-64; real memmap2 mapping; OpenHeartEngine::open serves queries without phases 1-9. SourceDelta derived from real old/new text (TextEdit -> tree_sitter::InputEdit); ordered RebuildScope fixes the classify bug; token/comment-aware classifier; commit diffs stable-id fingerprints and the new hash is the content digest (no XOR).
